subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should WebChat recover active runs from existing chat.history/chat.startup inFlightRun and session rows, add a new active-run hello snapshot, or fold this into a repaired replacement for PR #41067?
rationale: Current main has multiple partial state surfaces and the open PR is conflicting, so automation should not choose the permanent owner boundary for reconnect recovery without maintainer intent.

options.title: Use existing history/session state
options.body: Implement a narrower current-main repair that re-associates WebChat from chat.history/chat.startup inFlightRun and visible session rows, then validate reconnect behavior live.

options.title: Repair PR #41067
options.body: Rebase and reduce the open PR if maintainers want its broader snapshot/restart-notice approach to remain the canonical path.

options.title: Split termination diagnostics
options.body: Keep reconnect busy-state recovery separate from investigating embedded runs that terminate without a visible WebSocket reconnect.

recommendation.title: Use existing history/session state
recommendation.body: Implement a narrower current-main repair that re-associates WebChat from chat.history/chat.startup inFlightRun and visible session rows, then validate reconnect behavior live.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged history for chat history metadata and visible active-run filtering makes steipete the strongest available owner for the canonical state decision.
